prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one standalone finished illustration for the iOS narrative survival game Surviving LA. Mature restrained impressionist narrative oil painting, clearly visible impasto brushwork, atmospheric depth, realistic ordinary adult proportions, NOT photography. Midnight navy, charcoal, smoky blue and muted teal with localized coral orange and amber light. Landscape 1536x1024, 3:2, opaque PNG. A single scene, no collage. Put the decisive subject and cues across the middle horizontal band so they survive a wide 2.4:1 center crop; 10% margin at left and right. Lower 30% subdued dark low-detail. No readable text, letters, numbers, signage, logos, watermarks, UI, flags, celebrity likenesses, gore or heroic poses. Scene: fictional Los Angeles wildfire during Santa Ana winds. A tired ordinary middle-aged Chinese street vendor in a dark jacket, seen three-quarter from behind, pauses while pulling a handcart of closed boxes off a deserted palm-lined foothill street. At center background, scrub-covered San Gabriel foothills have a restrained but unmistakable orange fire line beneath a vast smoky slate sky. One fire engine farther down the road and distant low stucco homes, no skyscrapers. The cart and worried glance tell of cancelled market sales. Visible airborne ash, wind-bent palms, muted emergency light. Respectful disaster depiction; no injured people. Focus on displacement and interrupted livelihood, not spectacle.
